step1_analysis.description: A continuous-time CMOS comparator featuring a differential input pair with active loads, a differential-to-single-ended conversion stage, and an output inverter. It is likely used to generate pulse-width modulated (PWM) signals from analog pixel voltages in the active-pixel sensor.

paper_reference.title: A 1.0-V VDD CMOS Active-Pixel Sensor With Complementary Pixel Architecture and Pulsewidth Modulation Fabricated With a 0.25-m CMOS Process

power_consumption.description: Total DC power dissipation of the comparator.

sky130_expected.calculation: Tail current ~20uA (VBIAS=0.54V), second stage ~20uA, total current ~40uA. Power = 40uA * 1.8V = 72uW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Based on standard square-law current estimation for the given VBIAS and W/L ratios in SKY130.

propagation_delay.description: Average time delay between the input crossing the reference and the output crossing VDD/2.

sky130_expected.calculation: With 40uA total bias and small internal parasitic capacitances (~10fF), slew rate is high. Delay is dominated by the 3 stages. Expected ~2ns.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Typical delay for a 3-stage uncompensated comparator in 180nm/130nm class nodes.

offset_voltage.description: Input voltage difference required to trip the comparator output, indicating systematic mismatch.

sky130_expected.calculation: The asymmetric load (XM1, XM3 vs XM2, XM10) introduces a systematic offset. Depending on the exact sizing and feedback, it could be tens of mV.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Systematic offset due to circuit asymmetry.

hysteresis.description: Difference in trip points between rising and falling input signals.

sky130_expected.calculation: XM10 provides positive feedback from N1 to N0. Since loop gain is ~0.5, hysteresis might be zero or very small, but it alters the trip point dynamically.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Measured via forward and reverse DC sweeps.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure power consumption, propagation delay, offset voltage, and hysteresis of the comparator.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Comparator Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u
.param W_xm7=5u L_xm7=0.5u
.param W_xm8=5u L_xm8=0.5u
.param W_xm9=5u L_xm9=0.5u
.param W_xm10=5u L_xm10=0.5u
.param W_xm11=5u L_xm11=0.5u
.param W_xm12=5u L_xm12=0.5u
.param W_xm13=5u L_xm13=0.5u

VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VVBIAS VBIAS 0 0.54

* For Tran analysis
VMINUS VMINUS 0 0.9
VPLUS VPLUS 0 dc 0.9 pulse(0.7 1.1 5n 0.5n 0.5n 20n 40n)

* DUT
XM1 N0 N0 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N1 N1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 N0 N0 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 N3 VBIAS GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 N2 N4 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM6 N2 N1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}
XM7 N4 N0 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm7} w={W_xm7}
XM8 N1 VPLUS N3 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm8} w={W_xm8}
XM9 VOUT N2 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm9} w={W_xm9}
XM10 N0 N1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm10} w={W_xm10}
XM11 VOUT N2 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm11} w={W_xm11}
XM12 N4 N4 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm12} w={W_xm12}
XM13 N0 VMINUS N3 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm13} w={W_xm13}

.control
  * 1. DC Operating Point (Power)
  op
  let power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
  print power

  * 2. Transient Analysis (Delay)
  tran 0.1n 40n
  meas tran t_pHL trig v(VPLUS) val=0.9 rise=1 targ v(VOUT) val=0.9 fall=1
  meas tran t_pLH trig v(VPLUS) val=0.9 fall=1 targ v(VOUT) val=0.9 rise=1
  let delay_avg = (t_pHL + t_pLH) / 2
  print t_pHL t_pLH delay_avg

  * 3. DC Sweep Forward (Trip point & Offset)
  dc VPLUS 0.7 1.1 0.001
  meas dc v_trip_fwd when v(VOUT)=0.9 fall=1

  * 4. DC Sweep Reverse (Hysteresis)
  dc VPLUS 1.1 0.7 -0.001
  meas dc v_trip_rev when v(VOUT)=0.9 rise=1

  let hysteresis = v_trip_fwd - v_trip_rev
  let v_offset = (v_trip_fwd + v_trip_rev)/2 - 0.9
  print v_trip_fwd v_trip_rev hysteresis v_offset

  quit
.endc
.end
